thread:
Sophie (Partnerships): Quick sync — Northstar Consulting is asking for clarified lead routing and rules of engagement for marketplace + SI co-sell. Can we agree on routing & attribution today?
Miguel (Sales): +1. We need explicit mapping to AE territories and a deal registration step before co-sell commitments.
Anna (PM): Also need to confirm whether Northstar-originated leads count for marketplace referral credits.
Evan (SE): From the technical handoff side, SE should be looped at MQL -> Demo. Recommend tagging partner:Northstar in SFDC.
Sophie (Partnerships): Proposed rules (draft):
1) SI-originated inbound leads -> assigned to partner AE queue for 48h.
2) If no AE ack in 48h, auto-route to regional AE.
3) Deal registration required before sales co-sell commitment.
4) Pipeline attribution to partner if closed within 6 months.
Miguel (Sales): 48h window sounds good. If ACV > $50k escalate to AE manager within 24h.
Priya (Legal): Need NDA / data-sharing checkbox on the handoff form. I'll add wording.
Evan (SE): SE recommend adding these SFDC fields and mapping:
```
Lead fields:
- lead_source = Partner:NORTHSTAR
- partner_org = Northstar Consulting
- partner_rep = Miguel (Sales)
- partner_se = Evan (SE)
- deal_reg_id = <guid>
- partner_attribution_window = 6m
```
Sophie (Partnerships): Draft handoff email template (to be auto-sent to assigned AE):
```
Subject: Northstar lead intro — {company}
Hi {AE name},
Intro: Northstar has a prospect evaluating multi-region private deployments. Partner contact: {partner rep} (cc). Please acknowledge within 48h and update SFDC with deal_reg_id, partner tags, and partner_attribution_window.
Please confirm if you need SE enablement — tag partner_se.
Thanks,
Sophie (Partnerships)
```
Miguel (Sales): Can we add a pipeline attribution checkbox in SFDC so closers select "credit partner" on close?
Priya (Legal): 6 months looks OK. Add confidentiality checkbox & a short consent line for sharing customer info with the SI.
Anna (PM): For any joint marketplace listing / announcement: require joint PR review and mutual approval 10 business days prior. Add to playbook and to the marketplace onboarding checklist.
Sophie (Partnerships): I'll update the SI playbook with these rules and create PARTNERS-98 in JIRA to track action items.
dealbot: Deal registration created: REG-2026-001 by Northstar
Miguel (Sales): :thumbsup:
Sophie (Partnerships): I’ll circulate final rules, the SFDC field list, and email templates by EOD. Ping me if you have edits or objections.
